title: Wedding Journey - Yud Daled Kislev, Chasuna of the Rebbe & Rebbetzin

article.altBase: Wedding Journey - Yud Daled Kislev, Chasuna of the Rebbe & Rebbetzin
article.body:
lesson: The Frierdiker Rebbe gave special care to all the details leading up to the chasuna and, of course, to the wedding itself. The Rebbe said that "this is the day that connected me to you and you to me." How can we strengthen our connection to the Rebbe?

Diary of Reb Elya

14 Kislev missions
